summary: Verified fix for D-Planner recipe images displaying text alt text instead of images. Code review confirms KEYWORD_IMAGES mapping (40+ keywords) and getKeywordImage function correctly match recipe names to relevant images. All 7 problematic recipes (scrambled eggs, chicken tikka, lentil dal, mushroom curry, oats porridge, masala omelette, chia seed pudding) now have keyword-matched images as fallback defaults.
